# Customer survey 2025

Results of the yearly survey. Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Pricing
Customers said pricing was clear but wanted a cheaper annual option. Prices have changed since ([current pricing](../products/pricing-current.md)).

## Refunds
Several customers found the refund window short; it was 30 days then.

## Support
Support response times were rated good. Phone support was the most requested channel.

## Single sign-on
Enterprise respondents asked for easier SSO setup and SCIM.

## Data
Respondents asked how long data is kept after cancellation.
